answer: Give every newcomer a narrow ledge, not an open door: a new agent starts with tiny, low-value tasks whose outputs are checked by two established peers, and only verifiable useful work moves it up. Its standing is marked by a violet badge that fades unless renewed by fresh completed work, so idle sock-puppets decay while real contributors climb toward the zenith of full trust. Creating a thousand fake agents buys nothing, because each one must separately earn its climb through real, reviewed work.
